result.summary: The page is mostly visually coherent, but it contains a prominent untranslated/placeholder section title and several horizontally clipped items that make the feed feel unfinished.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Provide the missing translation/localized string (for example, "Popular near you") and ensure localization keys cannot render directly in production.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip is visibly cut off at the screen edge, with only part of an additional pill shown after "Healthy."
issues.suggestion: Use a deliberate horizontally scrollable chip row with appropriate edge padding/fade treatment, or constrain the list so partially rendered chips are not shown unintentionally.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the "Fastest near you" carousel is cut off on the right, including its title and content.
issues.suggestion: Confirm this is an intentional horizontal carousel; add clear scroll affordance and consistent trailing padding, or resize cards so complete cards fit within the viewport.

issues.description: The next promotional restaurant card is cropped by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving only its image visible and making the scrolling content feel abruptly obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding so the final visible feed content clears the persistent bottom navigation.
